name: emu-channel-delivery
description: Three provisioned firmware pagers on one ether. The sender (0,0) broadcasts a channel message; both receivers must render it on their e-paper. Asserted by run_scenarios.sh via `screen-assert -min-nodes 2 -text 'HELLO BRAMBLE'`. All three share EMU_NETWORK_KEY so the mesh carries the frame; the sender's EMU_AUTO_SEND fires mesh_send_broadcast after the receivers pass their 10s message-idle threshold, so an inbound message auto-opens their Messages screen where the text renders.
